page.notes: Page number read as "1" from a decorative numeral at top right; please confirm. The mark after "esse" is a small raised sign, transcribed as "*"; the note on the right carries the same mark. "ignorationc" is printed that way and is left as printed. The Greek "σεαυτόν" is uncertain and marked [?]. The verse reference "II. 11." is copied as it appears in the scan. Long s is normalised to plain s (eft → est, fiducia → fiduciæ, atteftatur → attestatur, hoftis → hostis). The page is the start of a division, so there is no running head. Show-through text at the top and the neighbouring page's edge at the left are excluded.
